turns.q: Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
turns.replyTail: d how to choose: - Essential underwear: quick-dry liner with zero absorbency (no leakproof protection). Best if you want a simple everyday pair. - Leakproof underwear: built-in liner that can absorb about 1–17 tsp (about 1–14 regular tampons). Best if you want coverage for sweat, discharge, spotting, periods, or light bladder leaks. If your priority is everyday comfort and budget, Essential underwear is usually the better fit; if you want extra protection day-to-day, go with Leakproof underwear.
